data.title: IDF fears surprise US attack on Iran as tensions rise over nuclear talks | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: To minimize risk of being caught off guard, the IDF is strengthening coordination with the US military and raising its level of alert across intelligence monitoring, early warning, and air defenses.
